edition.notes: The repository distributes Robinson's official BETA-code CCAT and Strong's files together with Unicode CSV forms generated from them by the repository's own conversion scripts; the repository states that Robinson's files remain the source of truth and that all code and text in it are in the public domain. The registered artifacts are the CSV form, not Robinson's official files, and their conversion input has not been separately acquired or hashed here. In-line braces mark apparatus notes: {NA x > y} records a Nestle-Aland divergence and {Byz x > y} an internal Byzantine variant. The apparatus is a divergence note, not a full critical apparatus.

passages.context: Physical CSV lines 114-116 contain the three complete verse records and were inspected together with 6:7-13. The file reads μαλακοί and ἀρσενοκοῖται in verse 9 and includes inline braced variant notes, which must not be silently conflated with the Byzantine running text.
passages.notes: The Greek places μαλακοί and ἀρσενοκοῖται together in verse 9. Historical Latin and Douay versification place their renderings in verse 10; that is a versification difference, not evidence that either Greek term is absent.

work.author: Maurice A. Robinson and William G. Pierpont
work.description: Robinson and Pierpont's edition of the Greek New Testament following the Byzantine textform, published in 2005 and revised in 2018. The maintained editions carry an apparatus recording Byzantine internal variants and divergences from the Nestle-Aland and Editio Critica Maior texts. The edition represents one textual tradition and is not a critical eclectic text; consumers state which readings they rely on and whether the apparatus records a divergence there.
work.title: The New Testament in the Original Greek: Byzantine Textform
